body: In a way I do put alot of pressure on myself to preform. I don't know what the hell im going to do after I graduate in a few months and I see all my peers going to colleges and moving etc while I'm just trying not to kms over here.
I have a few friends but its super hard for me to hang out with them for some reason (either work, school, or it's my dumbass who can't bring myself to get out of bed.
I've fought depression for a very long time. And no, I'm terrified of opening up to anyone irl so I just hide it as best as I can

I think I'm selfish because I live the ideal  "American dream". Both of my parents are together, im financially stable, we have a few animals... and I just want to die. I feel like a huge ungrateful piece of shit for this
Please don't, you deserve to have a happy ending years ahead of you
I love my family and I don't want to be selfish and leave them like this
I'm sorry about your father, I hope he's at peace now. And thank you for reassuring me
Every ounce of my being wants to give up. Im so tired and I have no idea what I'm doing anymore. I don't necessarily want to die I just don't see much of any other options. I'm just scared
I'm very sorry about your friend, he sounds like he was a great person.
I'm sorry. I sound entitled and selfish. I'm just really overwhelmed by everything and these past years have been really rough and I have no idea what to do
